question: What hyperbolic capacity of speech is invoked to express Tārā's greatness?
premises: Thousands of crores of mouths are imagined.
Hundreds of crores of tongues are imagined.
Even such capacity is invoked for description.
inference: Even thousands of crores of mouths and hundreds of crores of tongues are insufficient to fully express her greatness.
uncertainties: The main verb or completion of the thought continues beyond this verse.
plain_english: Even with thousands of crores of mouths and hundreds of crores of tongues.
